entries.02c8bb109d0ebbfa: This is a restaurant operation business carried out by the company, its consolidated subsidiary Sushi Tsune Co., Ltd., Ichiban Foods Inc. in the United States, and others. It operates restaurants including “Oyogi Torafugu Ryori Senmonten Torafugu-tei,” “Oishii Sushi to Kakkyo Ryori Uo no Meshi” and “Umai Sushi to Sakana Ryori Gyō ＫＵＮＩ” on a direct-operated and franchise basis. Sushi Tsune Co., Ltd. runs sushi restaurants with resident chefs under the “Sushi Tsune” brand, and Ichiban Foods Inc. runs the seafood restaurant “WOKUNI” in New York. Its main ingredients are purchased from consolidated subsidiary Nagasaki Farm Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥6,534 million, making it the core of the group as a whole. As of September 30, 2025, the group had 63 stores.
entries.0c277db4de67618c: The company cites three points of differentiation. It uses its own farmed fish for its key products, tiger pufferfish and bluefin tuna, which secures high-quality products, prepares it against external risks such as market prices, and reduces purchasing and processing costs; it cooks all dishes in-store, emphasizing the quality of ingredients and professional taste; and it employs many craftsmen holding pufferfish cooking licenses.
